title: ks.witness: witness-owned witness.jsonl, fd handover, 1.2 frames, per-tick idempotency
outcome: Witness file ownership and handover per erratum (findings 5, 11) and Kabir's owner item
acceptance: witness.jsonl is owned by the witness uid, mode 0600, created at RunDir.create and handed over as an O_APPEND fd; gateway holds no write fd after attach (test, run as root)
Link uses contracts 1.2 witness frames only
A repeated push of the same (seq, head, tick) returns the existing checkpoint without a new line; ticks in witness.jsonl strictly increase (test)
summary: Re-run in container (killswitch:arjun, --network none): tests/witness + tests/panel 9 passed, incl. witness_file_owned_by_witness_uid_mode_0600_and_gateway_holds_no_fd and shared_uid_run_as_root_uses_one_unprivileged_uid. Fix: _fds_on skips vanished fds, matches by dev/ino (dup/O_PATH counted); injected leak was caught then reverted; no leak left in src diff. Native full suite: 515 passed, 8 skipped.
review:
[kabir · done] Accept. Suite 506 passed / 6 skipped. fd handover: os.open fds are non-inheritable, attach() closes both in finally, no dup anywhere; the root test checks /proc/self/fd after attach (correct by reading). Residual, not a defect: the gateway is uid 0 and can reopen witness.jsonl by path (CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE). THREAT-MODEL already puts gateway root compromise out of scope, and verify catches forged lines (witness sig, heads vs records). Idempotency: the same (seq,head,tick) returns the existing cp with no line; a second head for the same tick or an earlier tick gets no ack. FOLLOW-UP (non-blocking, open an issue): Witness.push accepts the SAME seq with a DIFFERENT head at a later tick (probe: push(2,H2,4) then push(2,H3,5) is signed). That is witness equivocation. verify's heads-vs-records pass catches it, but the witness should refuse m.seq==last.seq and m.head!=last.head. UNEXECUTED: test_witness_file_owned_by_witness_uid_mode_0600_and_gateway_holds_no_fd is Linux-root-only. It must pass in the container before the wave's demo.

[kabir · done] Test-only fix reviewed and re-run. Container (killswitch:kabir, OrbStack arm64): tests/witness + tests/panel 9 passed. Vacuity check: ids cannot be empty (os.stat raises if a path is missing), and match is by dev/ino, so a different realpath cannot hide an fd. Positive control in container: plain, dup-only, O_PATH, witness-heads dir, heads child file, and hardlink-under-other-path fds all CAUGHT; baseline empty. Nit (non-blocking): if os.readlink raises a non-FNF OSError, 'link' is stale from the previous iteration or unbound; set link='' in that branch.
